profile_text: With a strong presence in Düsseldorf, Germany, this wholesale and retail trade company has experienced significant growth, increasing its workforce by 66.7% to 55 employees in 2024. As a specialist in the wholesale and retail trade sector, its focus on repair of motor vehicles and motorcycles has driven its expansion, categorizing it as a scaler. Its success can be attributed to its ability to adapt to the evolving needs of the automotive industry, although specific business activities remain undisclosed.
